headline: Weathered Expanse Rages as Linn Mercy Stirs Again
war_summary: Since the midday edition the heaviest fighting has concentrated in Weathered Expanse, with six changes in the last two hours and thirty-four on the day centered on Frostmarch, Crow's Nest and Shattered Advance to the filing minute, now standing five Warden, three Colonial and one destroyed with day losses about 13,629 Colonial and 17,656 Warden and both casualty rates accelerating. Linn Mercy has returned to the wire with two changes in the last two hours and twenty on the day all about Lathair, holding one Warden to ten Colonial with day losses near 2,851 Colonial and 5,715 Warden quickening sharply. Mooring County, Fisherman's Row and Godcrofts have gone quiet in the last two hours after three, two and three changes respectively in six hours, while Stlican Shelf, Farranac Coast and Stonecradle report no change in the last two hours despite eleven to thirty-five events on the day. Callahan's Passage and Nevish Line show no flips despite severe day losses above ten thousand Colonial in the former and accelerating hourly tolls in both.
